about: Every package and framework reference in this repository, each one reviewed. A reference that is not listed here fails the protocol tests, and so does an entry here that no project uses. Add an entry, with the reason, in the same pull request that adds the reference. See docs/adr/0009-dependencies-and-extensions.md.

references.name: Microsoft.AspNetCore.App
references.reason: The web server behind `present`. The plan moves it out of the CI build into a local build.

references.name: YamlDotNet
references.reason: Parses the root file. Read through its event parser only, with no reflection-based deserializer, and kept out of the protocol library, which takes no package references. The CLI reaches it through this library for `diffra record`, which adds about 180 KB to the CLI package. Kept for now; the intent is to vendor and trim it to the parser the root file needs.

references.name: YamlDotNet
references.reason: Reads the job dependencies from the workflow file, which the CI host's API does not report. The same version as the root-file library, read through its representation model only.

references.name: SharpFuzz
references.reason: Fuzzing harness for the canonical encoder and parsers. Test-only.

references.name: Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk
references.reason: Test host that mutation testing needs. Test-only.

references.name: xunit
references.reason: Test framework that mutation testing needs. Test-only.

references.name: xunit.runner.visualstudio
references.reason: Test adapter that mutation testing needs. Test-only.
